payload.title: Progression and evidence

sections.heading: Sequence
sections.text: Diagnose whole-number place value; reteach using a chart if needed. Model decimal places, guide responses, then require independent production. Compare decimals using equal units, teach against digit-count errors, then withhold assistance during end checks.

sections.heading: Delayed and new contexts
sections.text: Propose a delayed check after at least seven days, subject to an approved grade/subject policy. Use an unfamiliar measurement table for transfer. Neither opportunity is learning evidence until independently completed and verified.

payload.keyboardPath: Read headings and paragraphs in document order; enter responses in text or on paper.
payload.offlineInstructions: Print or cache this text. Record work on paper. No network, sound, colour or pointer movement is required.
